unverified.exam_name: The notice calls it an "evaluación" of language and of knowledge of history, geography, the Constitution, culture and current affairs; no formal name is given.
unverified.format: To be set by the regulation of the new law, which was still in consultation.

recent_change.summary: A new nationality law, Ley N.° 32421, replaced the old one: longer residence, an income threshold, and an evaluation of language and of history, geography, the Constitution, culture and current affairs. Applications already under way continue under the old law.
